## Domain

Retail, agriculture, smart glasses, mobile robots, logistics, healthcare, industrial, or another domain.

## Deployment Scenario

What is happening in the real world?

## Embodied Infrastructure

## Co-Embodiment Need

## Standards Questions

What interoperability gaps does this reveal?
